name: Lori A. Himes
occupation: Niobrara County assessor-elect taking office in January 2027 (official 2026 general results)
background: Lori A. Himes is the Niobrara County assessor-elect and takes office in January 2027, succeeding Teri Stephens, who is serving through the current term. The official 2026 general election summary lists her with 819 votes.
